::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 4th 1867  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 194
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd),
I hope this letter is a sufficient acknowledgement of the [£25](organizations/other_160.qmd), as I have no receipt stamp at hand and this village does not provide such articles, and as they must not be bought of the unprivileged[^1] I cannot beg or borrow too often from our worthy [neighbours](people/person_360.qmd) at the shop

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Unprivileged: Those without a license to sell.
